meanings.en: the quality of being ridiculous or completely unreasonable
meanings.exampleEn: She laughed at the absurdity of the situation.
meanings.exampleTr: Durumun saçmalığına güldü.

meanings.en: the quality of being practical and reasonable
meanings.exampleEn: Everyone admired the sensibleness of her decision.
meanings.exampleTr: Herkes kararının mantıklılığını takdir etti.

meanings.en: great injustice or wickedness
meanings.exampleEn: The novel exposes the iniquity of the old regime.
meanings.exampleTr: Roman, eski rejimin kötülüğünü gözler önüne serer.

meanings.en: a person who does not believe or is uncertain about something
meanings.exampleEn: He silenced the doubters by winning the championship.
meanings.exampleTr: Şampiyonluğu kazanarak şüphecileri susturdu.

meanings.en: a person who does not believe in something
meanings.exampleEn: As a lifelong disbeliever, she refused to accept the miracle story.
meanings.exampleTr: Ömür boyu inanmayan biri olarak mucize hikayesini kabul etmedi.

meanings.en: a person who believes in something, especially a religion or idea
meanings.exampleEn: She is a firm believer in hard work.
meanings.exampleTr: O, çok çalışmaya sıkı sıkıya inanan biridir.

meanings.en: a sloping direction or position
meanings.exampleEn: The roof has a steep slant to let the rain run off.
meanings.exampleTr: Çatının, yağmurun akması için dik bir eğimi var.

meanings.en: a particular way of presenting or looking at something
meanings.exampleEn: The article gave a political slant to the news.
meanings.exampleTr: Makale habere siyasi bir bakış açısı kattı.

meanings.en: a person who avoids work or duty
meanings.exampleEn: The manager had no patience for shirkers on the team.
meanings.exampleTr: Yönetici, takımdaki kaytarıcılara hiç tahammül etmezdi.

meanings.en: the quality of being thin and graceful
meanings.exampleEn: The slenderness of the dancer's frame was striking.
meanings.exampleTr: Dansçının bedeninin inceliği çok dikkat çekiciydi.

meanings.en: the quality of being rather fat or heavily built
meanings.exampleEn: His stoutness made climbing the stairs difficult.
meanings.exampleTr: Tıknazlığı merdiven çıkmasını zorlaştırıyordu.

meanings.en: in a messy or disorganized way
meanings.exampleEn: The papers were piled untidily on the desk.
meanings.exampleTr: Kağıtlar masanın üzerine düzensizce yığılmıştı.

meanings.en: in a dirty or untidy way
meanings.exampleEn: The child ate messily, spilling food everywhere.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuk her yeri dökerek dağınık bir şekilde yedi.

meanings.en: a person who makes and repairs things made of iron by hand
meanings.exampleEn: The blacksmith forged a new horseshoe over the fire.
meanings.exampleTr: Demirci ateşin üzerinde yeni bir at nalı dövdü.

meanings.en: a person who makes things from metal
meanings.exampleEn: The skilled metalworker shaped the copper into a bowl.
meanings.exampleTr: Usta metal işçisi bakırı bir kaseye dönüştürdü.

meanings.en: the quality of being level, smooth, or equal
meanings.exampleEn: The evenness of the surface made painting easy.
meanings.exampleTr: Yüzeyin düzgünlüğü boyamayı kolaylaştırdı.

meanings.en: the quality of being smooth, shiny, and elegant
meanings.exampleEn: The sleekness of the new car impressed everyone.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni arabanın şık ve düzgün görünümü herkesi etkiledi.

meanings.en: in a cheerful and carefree way
meanings.exampleEn: They chatted light-heartedly about their holiday plans.
meanings.exampleTr: Tatil planları hakkında neşeyle sohbet ettiler.

meanings.en: desired or wanted very much by many people
meanings.exampleEn: She won the coveted award for best actress.
meanings.exampleTr: En iyi kadın oyuncu ödülü olan o çok istenen ödülü kazandı.

meanings.en: the means of earning money to live
meanings.exampleEn: Fishing is the main livelihood of the village.
meanings.exampleTr: Balıkçılık köyün başlıca geçim kaynağıdır.

meanings.en: having the freedom to govern or act independently
meanings.exampleEn: The region became an autonomous state after the treaty.
meanings.exampleTr: Bölge, antlaşmadan sonra özerk bir devlet oldu.

meanings.en: able to operate without direct human control
meanings.exampleEn: Autonomous vehicles can drive without a human driver.
meanings.exampleTr: Otonom araçlar bir insan sürücü olmadan gidebilir.

meanings.en: covering a wide area; large in size or scope
meanings.exampleEn: The hotel offered expansive views of the ocean.
meanings.exampleTr: Otel okyanusun geniş manzarasını sunuyordu.

meanings.en: willing to talk openly and in a friendly, generous way
meanings.exampleEn: After dinner he became expansive and told many stories.
meanings.exampleTr: Yemekten sonra açılıp konuşkanlaştı ve birçok hikaye anlattı.

meanings.en: the state of being insufficient in quantity or amount
meanings.exampleEn: The scantiness of the evidence weakened the case.
meanings.exampleTr: Kanıtların yetersizliği davayı zayıflattı.

meanings.en: marked with spots or small round patches
meanings.exampleEn: She wore a spotted dress to the party.
meanings.exampleTr: Partiye benekli bir elbise giydi.

meanings.en: marked with spots or patches of light and shade or colour
meanings.exampleEn: Sunlight filtered through the leaves, leaving the ground dappled.
meanings.exampleTr: Güneş ışığı yaprakların arasından süzülerek yeri alacalı bıraktı.

meanings.en: marked with small spots or patches of colour
meanings.exampleEn: His hair was flecked with grey.
meanings.exampleTr: Saçları grinin küçük benekleriyle kaplıydı.

meanings.en: a strong, sharp taste or smell
meanings.exampleEn: The pungency of the spices filled the kitchen.
meanings.exampleTr: Baharatların keskinliği mutfağı doldurdu.

meanings.en: a device that controls the flow of liquid, gas, or air through a pipe
meanings.exampleEn: Turn the valve to stop the water flow.
meanings.exampleTr: Su akışını durdurmak için vanayı çevir.

meanings.en: something that develops from something larger and more established
meanings.exampleEn: The company started as an offshoot of a larger firm.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket, daha büyük bir firmanın yan kuruluşu olarak başladı.

meanings.en: something produced as a result of making something else
meanings.exampleEn: Sawdust is a byproduct of the timber industry.
meanings.exampleTr: Talaş, kereste endüstrisinin bir yan ürünüdür.

meanings.en: an unexpected result of an event or activity
meanings.exampleEn: Stress is often a byproduct of a demanding job.
meanings.exampleTr: Stres genellikle zorlu bir işin yan ürünüdür.

meanings.en: the line of bones down the middle of the back; the spine
meanings.exampleEn: He injured his backbone in the accident.
meanings.exampleTr: Kazada omurgasını yaraladı.

meanings.en: the most important part of something that provides support
meanings.exampleEn: Small farms are the backbone of the rural economy.
meanings.exampleTr: Küçük çiftlikler kırsal ekonominin bel kemiğidir.

meanings.en: having a strong desire for revenge
meanings.exampleEn: She was so vindictive that she never forgave a slight.
meanings.exampleTr: O kadar kinciydi ki en ufak bir hakareti bile affetmezdi.

meanings.en: the quality of being extremely beautiful, impressive, or grand
meanings.exampleEn: Visitors were amazed by the magnificence of the palace.
meanings.exampleTr: Ziyaretçiler sarayın ihtişamına hayran kaldı.

meanings.en: the quality of being natural and not artificial or forced
meanings.exampleEn: The naturalness of her acting made the film believable.
meanings.exampleTr: Oyunculuğunun doğallığı filmi inandırıcı kıldı.

meanings.en: a wheel with teeth around the edge that turns another wheel
meanings.exampleEn: The clock stopped when a gearwheel broke.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir dişli çark kırılınca saat durdu.

meanings.en: to gradually disappear or make something disappear
meanings.exampleEn: The morning fog began to dissipate as the sun rose.
meanings.exampleTr: Güneş doğdukça sabah sisi dağılmaya başladı.

meanings.en: to waste money, energy, or time
meanings.exampleEn: He dissipated his fortune on gambling.
meanings.exampleTr: Servetini kumarda çarçur etti.

meanings.en: to protect something or use it carefully to prevent waste
meanings.exampleEn: We must conserve water during the drought.
meanings.exampleTr: Kuraklık sırasında suyu tasarruflu kullanmalıyız.

meanings.en: a person who wastes money, time, or resources
meanings.exampleEn: He was a waster who spent every penny he earned.
meanings.exampleTr: Kazandığı her kuruşu harcayan savurgan biriydi.

meanings.en: a person who saves money rather than spending it
meanings.exampleEn: The bank offers higher interest to regular savers.
meanings.exampleTr: Banka, düzenli tasarruf edenlere daha yüksek faiz sunar.

meanings.en: an adult male deer, especially a red deer
meanings.exampleEn: A great hart stood at the edge of the forest.
meanings.exampleTr: Ormanın kenarında iri bir erkek geyik duruyordu.

meanings.en: a situation in which neither side in a conflict can win or make progress
meanings.exampleEn: The negotiations ended in a tense standoff.
meanings.exampleTr: Müzakereler gergin bir çıkmazla sonuçlandı.

meanings.en: the quality of being level and smooth without curves or bumps
meanings.exampleEn: The flatness of the plain stretched to the horizon.
meanings.exampleTr: Ovanın düzlüğü ufka kadar uzanıyordu.

meanings.en: the quality of being dull or lacking interest or emotion
meanings.exampleEn: The flatness of his voice showed how tired he was.
meanings.exampleTr: Sesinin cansızlığı ne kadar yorgun olduğunu gösteriyordu.

meanings.en: to make something return to a normal or standard condition
meanings.exampleEn: The two countries agreed to normalize relations.
meanings.exampleTr: İki ülke ilişkileri normalleştirmeyi kabul etti.

meanings.tr: düzene sokmak, kurala uygun hale getirmek
meanings.en: to make something official, regular, or in accordance with rules
meanings.exampleEn: The government moved to regularize the status of the workers.
meanings.exampleTr: Hükümet işçilerin durumunu düzene sokmak için harekete geçti.

meanings.en: to organize something according to a fixed plan or system
meanings.exampleEn: She tried to systematize the messy filing process.
meanings.exampleTr: Dağınık dosyalama sürecini sistemleştirmeye çalıştı.

meanings.en: a hidden store of things such as weapons, food, or money
meanings.exampleEn: Police discovered a cache of weapons in the basement.
meanings.exampleTr: Polis bodrumda bir silah zulası buldu.

meanings.en: a part of a computer's memory that stores data for quick access
meanings.exampleEn: Clearing the browser cache can fix loading problems.
meanings.exampleTr: Tarayıcı önbelleğini temizlemek yükleme sorunlarını çözebilir.
